scope: Deterministic local draft contract checks with form doubles; not a browser navigation test, human usability study, or detection benchmark.

checks.name: text whitespace and exact characters survive capture and restore
metadata fields survive a serializable snapshot roundtrip
quick and modal case keys do not overwrite each other
capture whitelist excludes secrets files and hidden controls
restore uses value assignment and never interprets user HTML
readonly campaign metadata is not replaced by an older form draft
unchanged input and change events do not emit duplicate records
external mutation of a callback or snapshot cannot change store contents
example replacement preserves the previous manually entered text
switching two examples keeps the original manual text
manual edits after an example become the next recoverable input
previous input survives reload through text-only snapshot
clear success removes current text previous text and files for one key
file objects remain only in memory and disappear on serialized reload
file limits reject new selection without replacing earlier files
aggregate file memory is bounded across draft keys
unknown keys and record schemas cannot enter the map
text and metadata length bounds apply to untrusted records
invalid select values are excluded instead of restored into controls
100-draft limit refuses a new key without silently evicting old input
file-only drafts also count toward the 100-key limit
serialized text budget refuses addition without damaging prior records
installer captures input without rendering or stealing focus and detaches
installer ignores unrelated and file inputs and reports bounded errors
untouched default draft does not block restoration
meaningful current text blocks conflicting restoration
current memory files prevent replacement of empty draft
previous manual text is protected even if examples match
matching content may be restored despite a different timestamp
